      "expected_id": "E0001",
      "summary": "高速侧的「驶离高速」动作（`:13` 与 `:15` 的 `dist_to_exit<2`）被接到了 `FinishState` 上，而 NL 第 6 句说进入 FinishState 的条件是 `auto_finished=true`——距出口 2 公里即宣告整个自动驾驶完成。",
      "detail": "NL 第 4 句与第 5 句把 `dist_to_exit<2` 用于「驶离高速」这个局部动作；NL 第 6 句把「整个自动驾驶阶段结束」的条件规定为 `auto_finished=true`。\n\n制品把两者合并到了同一个目标上：`:13 lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 与 `:15 cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 的目标都是 `FinishState`；而 `:16 cruise --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 也指向同一个。\n\n按第一种读法，后果是车辆只要驶到离高速出口不足 2 公里，系统就会进入表示自动驾驶完成的状态，而 `auto_finished` 此时并不成立。\n\n对照城市侧：NL 第 8 句为同一类动作命名了 `exit_urban`，制品在 `:25 lane_change_urban --> exit_urban : dist_to_exit<0.7` 正确地建了它。也就是说作者在城市侧区分了局部退出与全局完成，高速侧没有——但那是因为 NL 在高速侧本来就没给局部退出命名目标。\n\n本条与 pair 0009 的 EIS-0009-01 同一 NL 组、同一读法、同判 D1。",
      "source_statement": "NL 4/5 的 dist_to_exit<2 是局部驶离高速，NL 6 明确只有 auto_finished=true 才进 FinishState。生成侧把两者合并，使距出口 2 公里即宣告自动驾驶完成，与 NL 6 冲突。",

      "summary": "`FinishState` 因为首次出现在 `:13`（`HighwayMode` 块内）而被钉成 HighwayMode 的子态，于是 `:28`/`:30` 这些城市侧的完成路径会先把系统路由回 `HighwayMode` 再进入其内部的 FinishState。",
      "detail": "NL 第 6 句与第 10 句都用裸名 FinishState，没有任何限定把它们区分成两个不同状态；上游参考模型也只建了一个共享的 FinishState，位置在自动驾驶模式这一层。\n\n制品把它建进了 `HighwayMode`。PlantUML 按名字首次出现的位置确定作用域，`FinishState` 首次出现在 `:13 lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2`，而 `:13` 在 `state HighwayMode {`（:8）与 `}`（:17）之间。\n\n后果落在城市侧的两条完成边上：`:28 straight --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 与 `:30 intersection --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`，两条都写在 `state UrbanMode {`（:19-:31）块内，目标却是 HighwayMode 内部的一个叶态。层次状态机里进入深层子态必须先进入它的全部祖先，所以实际执行序列是：离开 UrbanMode，进入 HighwayMode，再进入 HighwayMode 内的 FinishState。用一句话说就是「城市模式完成反而使高速模式变为活跃」。`:43 AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 同理。\n\n这与 EIS-0049-01 是两条独立的缺陷：那一条说 `dist_to_exit<2` 的目标选错了，本条说 `FinishState` 本身建错了层级。即便把 `:13`/`:15` 改成通向一个局部退出态，本条仍然成立。\n\n第一版台账没有记录本条。同一份 NL 的 pair 0009（EIS-0009-03）与 pair 0029（EIS-0029-05）上有同型条目。",

      "summary": "`FinishState` 因 `:13` 被限定在 `HighwayMode` 内，进入之后仍在 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 这条成组迁移的作用域里——「结束」之后会被带回城市模式，再经 `:34` 回来、由 `:15` 回到 FinishState，构成一个环。",
      "detail": "先把承重的与不承重的分开。\n\n**不承重的那一半**：全文 `--> [*]` 计数为 0（`:38` 是方向相反的 `[*] -->` 初始边，不算）。这个事实成立，但「模型必须有根级终止汇点」不构成一条 NL 给出的义务。\n\n**承重的那一半**：`FinishState` 归属 `HighwayMode`（同 EIS-0049-02）。而 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 是一条以 `HighwayMode` 为源的成组迁移，对它的全部后代生效，包括 `FinishState`。于是进入 `FinishState` 之后，只要 `urban_way=true` 成立就会被带到 `UrbanMode`；再由 `:34 UrbanMode --> HighwayMode : high_way=true` 回来，经 `:9` 的默认入口落到 `enter_hwy`、走到 `cruise`，最后由 `:15` 或 `:16` 再回到 `FinishState`——一个可以反复走的环。`:43 AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 则会让整个 `AutonomousMode` 退出并重入。\n\n所以作者用来表达终止的那个状态并不真正终止任何东西。\n\n被违反的是 NL 第 6 句「The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition」所表达的终止意图。",
      "source_statement": "根因是模型没有根级终止汇点：全文 `--> [*]` 计数为 0（:38 是方向相反的 `[*] -->` 初始边）。NL 的终点 FinishState 又因 :13 被限定在 HighwayMode 内，进入后仍被 :33 `HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 带走（再由 :34 回来、经 enter_hwy/cruise 由 :15 回到 FinishState 成环），且 :43 使整个 AutonomousMode 退出重入。终止意图在作者源上即失效。",

        "content": "1. The system begins in the AutonomousMode state, which transitions into the InitialState substate, marking the starting point of the autonomous driving mode. \n2. If the system is in lane_change, it can return to cruise once the lane change is completed or exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`). \n5. In the cruise substate, if the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 25 meters (`dist_to_front<25`) and there is an extra lane available, the system transitions to lane_change. In the lane_change_urban substate, the system transitions to straight if the lane change is complete or to exit_urban if the distance to the urban exit is less than 0.7 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<0.7`). \n9. In the straight substate, if the system detects an intersection, it transitions to the intersection substate. If the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 15 meters (`dist_to_front<15`) and an extra lane is available, it transitions to lane_change_urban. \n10. The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied. \n11. The system supports dynamic transitions between HighwayMode and UrbanMode based on the conditions `urban_way=true` and `high_way=true`, respectively, facilitating seamless mode shifts during the drive. \n12. The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state. You may not reopen, weaken, strengthen, or rewrite that validity certificate. Judge only the relation between this valid report and every supplied expected issue.

For each exact expected position, output one relation:
- FULL_MATCH for the same defect instance, root cause, violated obligation, direct attributable symptom, or independently actionable core facet whose repair eliminates or materially mitigates the expected core violation.
- PARTIAL_MATCH for a real artifact-supported local or indirect relationship that is insufficient for unique attribution. PARTIAL contributes support only, never a hit or false positive.
- NO_MATCH for a different issue, source, property, direction, repair obligation, or merely shared terminology or nearby model context.

Read each expected issue's summary and complete detail together. Decompose a composite expected issue into every explicitly stated independently actionable causal facet. A valid report FULL-matches when its own bounded claim identifies one such core facet and its repair materially mitigates the expected violation; it need not also identify every coequal facet in the same expected issue. Do not downgrade that exact actionable-facet relation to PARTIAL merely because another expected facet has a different carrier or representation. PARTIAL is reserved for genuine but non-unique local or indirect overlap.

Conversely, never expand the report to a different defect merely because the common artifacts independently establish it. Relation scope is bounded by the report's claim and complete causal fields frozen in the validity certificate. An absence asserted for one carrier, owner, source scope, or repair obligation does not assert a different absent entry, transition, effect, region, or owner-level carrier. Statements that the observed model contains "only" some carriers remain bounded by the technical claim they support; unmentioned obligations at another hierarchy level are not report findings. A report may FULL-match multiple expected issues only when each mapping is independently stated by the report and has its own expected-specific reason and basis. A missing operational transition may be a direct actionable facet of a broader reachability, no-progress, or pure-stub issue when that same transition absence is explicit in the expected mechanism and the repair materially mitigates it; do not transfer it to a distinct entry, ownership, region, or narrow-edge obligation.

Complete every exact expected position once in schema order. An omitted row never defaults to NO. Every FULL, PARTIAL, and NO row must include expected-specific English reason, basis, and supplied source references; FULL and PARTIAL rows must additionally include report-owned field references. Return the exact frozen validity certificate hash unchanged.

Respect typed carriers and artifact authority. Body text, labels, aliases, and descriptions are not executable lifecycle actions or transition effects. An initial transition inside a child composite is not a parent-level entry and applies only after its owner is active; it is not an active-state continuation or evidence of sibling concurrency. Do not infer semantic equivalence from names, shared locus, generated lowering members, or taxonomy labels alone. Report and expected IDs are anonymous keys. Experimental metadata, evidence levels, predicate families, and historical outcomes are not matching gates. Write every generated value in English except immutable provider-external quotations.

      "expected_id": "E0001",
      "summary": "高速侧的「驶离高速」动作（`:13` 与 `:15` 的 `dist_to_exit<2`）被接到了 `FinishState` 上，而 NL 第 6 句说进入 FinishState 的条件是 `auto_finished=true`——距出口 2 公里即宣告整个自动驾驶完成。",
      "detail": "NL 第 4 句与第 5 句把 `dist_to_exit<2` 用于「驶离高速」这个局部动作；NL 第 6 句把「整个自动驾驶阶段结束」的条件规定为 `auto_finished=true`。\n\n制品把两者合并到了同一个目标上：`:13 lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 与 `:15 cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 的目标都是 `FinishState`；而 `:16 cruise --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 也指向同一个。\n\n按第一种读法，后果是车辆只要驶到离高速出口不足 2 公里，系统就会进入表示自动驾驶完成的状态，而 `auto_finished` 此时并不成立。\n\n对照城市侧：NL 第 8 句为同一类动作命名了 `exit_urban`，制品在 `:25 lane_change_urban --> exit_urban : dist_to_exit<0.7` 正确地建了它。也就是说作者在城市侧区分了局部退出与全局完成，高速侧没有——但那是因为 NL 在高速侧本来就没给局部退出命名目标。\n\n本条与 pair 0009 的 EIS-0009-01 同一 NL 组、同一读法、同判 D1。",

      "summary": "`FinishState` 因为首次出现在 `:13`（`HighwayMode` 块内）而被钉成 HighwayMode 的子态，于是 `:28`/`:30` 这些城市侧的完成路径会先把系统路由回 `HighwayMode` 再进入其内部的 FinishState。",
      "detail": "NL 第 6 句与第 10 句都用裸名 FinishState，没有任何限定把它们区分成两个不同状态；上游参考模型也只建了一个共享的 FinishState，位置在自动驾驶模式这一层。\n\n制品把它建进了 `HighwayMode`。PlantUML 按名字首次出现的位置确定作用域，`FinishState` 首次出现在 `:13 lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2`，而 `:13` 在 `state HighwayMode {`（:8）与 `}`（:17）之间。\n\n后果落在城市侧的两条完成边上：`:28 straight --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 与 `:30 intersection --> FinishState : auto_finished=true`，两条都写在 `state UrbanMode {`（:19-:31）块内，目标却是 HighwayMode 内部的一个叶态。层次状态机里进入深层子态必须先进入它的全部祖先，所以实际执行序列是：离开 UrbanMode，进入 HighwayMode，再进入 HighwayMode 内的 FinishState。用一句话说就是「城市模式完成反而使高速模式变为活跃」。`:43 AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 同理。\n\n这与 EIS-0049-01 是两条独立的缺陷：那一条说 `dist_to_exit<2` 的目标选错了，本条说 `FinishState` 本身建错了层级。即便把 `:13`/`:15` 改成通向一个局部退出态，本条仍然成立。\n\n第一版台账没有记录本条。同一份 NL 的 pair 0009（EIS-0009-03）与 pair 0029（EIS-0029-05）上有同型条目。",

      "summary": "`FinishState` 因 `:13` 被限定在 `HighwayMode` 内，进入之后仍在 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 这条成组迁移的作用域里——「结束」之后会被带回城市模式，再经 `:34` 回来、由 `:15` 回到 FinishState，构成一个环。",
      "detail": "先把承重的与不承重的分开。\n\n**不承重的那一半**：全文 `--> [*]` 计数为 0（`:38` 是方向相反的 `[*] -->` 初始边，不算）。这个事实成立，但「模型必须有根级终止汇点」不构成一条 NL 给出的义务。\n\n**承重的那一半**：`FinishState` 归属 `HighwayMode`（同 EIS-0049-02）。而 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 是一条以 `HighwayMode` 为源的成组迁移，对它的全部后代生效，包括 `FinishState`。于是进入 `FinishState` 之后，只要 `urban_way=true` 成立就会被带到 `UrbanMode`；再由 `:34 UrbanMode --> HighwayMode : high_way=true` 回来，经 `:9` 的默认入口落到 `enter_hwy`、走到 `cruise`，最后由 `:15` 或 `:16` 再回到 `FinishState`——一个可以反复走的环。`:43 AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 则会让整个 `AutonomousMode` 退出并重入。\n\n所以作者用来表达终止的那个状态并不真正终止任何东西。\n\n被违反的是 NL 第 6 句「The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition」所表达的终止意图。",
      "source_statement": "根因是模型没有根级终止汇点：全文 `--> [*]` 计数为 0（:38 是方向相反的 `[*] -->` 初始边）。NL 的终点 FinishState 又因 :13 被限定在 HighwayMode 内，进入后仍被 :33 `HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 带走（再由 :34 回来、经 enter_hwy/cruise 由 :15 回到 FinishState 成环），且 :43 使整个 AutonomousMode 退出重入。终止意图在作者源上即失效。",

In the HighwayMode state, the system begins in the enter_hwy substate, and can transition to cruise or lane_change based on the distance to the front vehicle (`dist_to_front<25`) and the availability of an extra lane (`extra_lane=true`). \n4. If the system is in lane_change, it can return to cruise once the lane change is completed or exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`). \n5. In the cruise substate, if the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 25 meters (`dist_to_front<25`) and there is an extra lane available, the system transitions to lane_change. The system can also exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`). \n6. The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition. \n7. In UrbanMode, the system begins in the enter_urban substate. From here, it can transition to lane_change_urban if the distance to the front vehicle is less than 15 meters (`dist_to_front<15`) and an extra lane is available, or straight if the road ahead is clear, or intersection if it detects an intersection (`intersection=true`). \n8. In the lane_change_urban substate, the system transitions to straight if the lane change is complete or to exit_urban if the distance to the urban exit is less than 0.7 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<0.7`). \n9. In the straight substate, if the system detects an intersection, it transitions to the intersection substate. If the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 15 meters (`dist_to_front<15`) and an extra lane is available, it transitions to lane_change_urban. \n10. The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied. \n11. The system supports dynamic transitions between HighwayMode and UrbanMode based on the conditions `urban_way=true` and `high_way=true`, respectively, facilitating seamless mode shifts during the drive. \n12. The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state. It transitions to collision_avoidance_active when certain conditions are met, such as detecting pedestrians (`pedestrian_detected`), the rear distance being less than 5 meters with a velocity over 30 km/h (`dist_to_rear<5 & vel>30`), or the front distance being less than 15 meters in highway mode or 10 meters in urban mode. \n13. Once in the collision_avoidance_active state, the collision avoidance system returns to the collision_avoidance_deactive state when there is no active danger, as indicated by the conditions `front_inactive`, `rear_inactive`, and `pedestrian_inactive`.",

      "expected_id": "E0001",
      "summary": "高速侧的「驶离高速」动作（`:13` 与 `:15` 的 `dist_to_exit<2`）被接到了 `FinishState` 上，而 NL 第 6 句说进入 FinishState 的条件是 `auto_finished=true`——距出口 2 公里即宣告整个自动驾驶完成。",
      "detail": "NL 第 4 句与第 5 句把 `dist_to_exit<2` 用于「驶离高速」这个局部动作；NL 第 6 句把「整个自动驾驶阶段结束」的条件规定为 `auto_finished=true`。\n\n制品把两者合并到了同一个目标上：`:13 lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 与 `:15 cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 的目标都是 `FinishState`；而 `:16 cruise --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 也指向同一个。\n\n按第一种读法，后果是车辆只要驶到离高速出口不足 2 公里，系统就会进入表示自动驾驶完成的状态，而 `auto_finished` 此时并不成立。\n\n对照城市侧：NL 第 8 句为同一类动作命名了 `exit_urban`，制品在 `:25 lane_change_urban --> exit_urban : dist_to_exit<0.7` 正确地建了它。也就是说作者在城市侧区分了局部退出与全局完成，高速侧没有——但那是因为 NL 在高速侧本来就没给局部退出命名目标。\n\n本条与 pair 0009 的 EIS-0009-01 同一 NL 组、同一读法、同判 D1。",
      "source_statement": "NL 4/5 的 dist_to_exit<2 是局部驶离高速，NL 6 明确只有 auto_finished=true 才进 FinishState。生成侧把两者合并，使距出口 2 公里即宣告自动驾驶完成，与 NL 6 冲突。",

      "summary": "`FinishState` 因 `:13` 被限定在 `HighwayMode` 内，进入之后仍在 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 这条成组迁移的作用域里——「结束」之后会被带回城市模式，再经 `:34` 回来、由 `:15` 回到 FinishState，构成一个环。",
      "detail": "先把承重的与不承重的分开。\n\n**不承重的那一半**：全文 `--> [*]` 计数为 0（`:38` 是方向相反的 `[*] -->` 初始边，不算）。这个事实成立，但「模型必须有根级终止汇点」不构成一条 NL 给出的义务。\n\n**承重的那一半**：`FinishState` 归属 `HighwayMode`（同 EIS-0049-02）。而 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 是一条以 `HighwayMode` 为源的成组迁移，对它的全部后代生效，包括 `FinishState`。于是进入 `FinishState` 之后，只要 `urban_way=true` 成立就会被带到 `UrbanMode`；再由 `:34 UrbanMode --> HighwayMode : high_way=true` 回来，经 `:9` 的默认入口落到 `enter_hwy`、走到 `cruise`，最后由 `:15` 或 `:16` 再回到 `FinishState`——一个可以反复走的环。`:43 AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 则会让整个 `AutonomousMode` 退出并重入。\n\n所以作者用来表达终止的那个状态并不真正终止任何东西。\n\n被违反的是 NL 第 6 句「The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition」所表达的终止意图。",

        "content": "1. The system begins in the AutonomousMode state, which transitions into the InitialState substate, marking the starting point of the autonomous driving mode. \n2. If the system is in lane_change, it can return to cruise once the lane change is completed or exit the highway if the distance to the exit is less than 2 kilometers (`dist_to_exit<2`). \n5. In the cruise substate, if the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 25 meters (`dist_to_front<25`) and there is an extra lane available, the system transitions to lane_change. If the distance to the front vehicle becomes less than 15 meters (`dist_to_front<15`) and an extra lane is available, it transitions to lane_change_urban. \n10. The system exits the UrbanMode state by transitioning to FinishState once `auto_finished=true` is satisfied. \n11. The system supports dynamic transitions between HighwayMode and UrbanMode based on the conditions `urban_way=true` and `high_way=true`, respectively, facilitating seamless mode shifts during the drive. \n12. The collision avoidance system is initially in the collision_avoidance_deactive state. You are an anonymous semantic-relation Judge for state-machine issue discovery. The report's artifact validity has already been frozen by an expected-isolated stage. You may not reopen, weaken, strengthen, or rewrite that validity certificate. Judge only the relation between this valid report and every supplied expected issue.

For each exact expected position, output one relation:
- FULL_MATCH for the same defect instance, root cause, violated obligation, direct attributable symptom, or independently actionable core facet whose repair eliminates or materially mitigates the expected core violation.
- PARTIAL_MATCH for a real artifact-supported local or indirect relationship that is insufficient for unique attribution. PARTIAL contributes support only, never a hit or false positive.
- NO_MATCH for a different issue, source, property, direction, repair obligation, or merely shared terminology or nearby model context.

Read each expected issue's summary and complete detail together. Decompose a composite expected issue into every explicitly stated independently actionable causal facet. A valid report FULL-matches when its own bounded claim identifies one such core facet and its repair materially mitigates the expected violation; it need not also identify every coequal facet in the same expected issue. Do not downgrade that exact actionable-facet relation to PARTIAL merely because another expected facet has a different carrier or representation. PARTIAL is reserved for genuine but non-unique local or indirect overlap.

Conversely, never expand the report to a different defect merely because the common artifacts independently establish it.       "summary": "高速侧的「驶离高速」动作（`:13` 与 `:15` 的 `dist_to_exit<2`）被接到了 `FinishState` 上，而 NL 第 6 句说进入 FinishState 的条件是 `auto_finished=true`——距出口 2 公里即宣告整个自动驾驶完成。",
      "detail": "NL 第 4 句与第 5 句把 `dist_to_exit<2` 用于「驶离高速」这个局部动作；NL 第 6 句把「整个自动驾驶阶段结束」的条件规定为 `auto_finished=true`。\n\n制品把两者合并到了同一个目标上：`:13 lane_change --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 与 `:15 cruise --> FinishState : dist_to_exit<2` 的目标都是 `FinishState`；而 `:16 cruise --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 也指向同一个。\n\n按第一种读法，后果是车辆只要驶到离高速出口不足 2 公里，系统就会进入表示自动驾驶完成的状态，而 `auto_finished` 此时并不成立。\n\n对照城市侧：NL 第 8 句为同一类动作命名了 `exit_urban`，制品在 `:25 lane_change_urban --> exit_urban : dist_to_exit<0.7` 正确地建了它。也就是说作者在城市侧区分了局部退出与全局完成，高速侧没有——但那是因为 NL 在高速侧本来就没给局部退出命名目标。\n\n本条与 pair 0009 的 EIS-0009-01 同一 NL 组、同一读法、同判 D1。",

      "summary": "`FinishState` 因为首次出现在 `:13`（`HighwayMode` 块内）而被钉成 HighwayMode 的子态，于是 `:28`/`:30` 这些城市侧的完成路径会先把系统路由回 `HighwayMode` 再进入其内部的 FinishState。",

      "detail": "先把承重的与不承重的分开。\n\n**不承重的那一半**：全文 `--> [*]` 计数为 0（`:38` 是方向相反的 `[*] -->` 初始边，不算）。这个事实成立，但「模型必须有根级终止汇点」不构成一条 NL 给出的义务。\n\n**承重的那一半**：`FinishState` 归属 `HighwayMode`（同 EIS-0049-02）。而 `:33 HighwayMode --> UrbanMode : urban_way=true` 是一条以 `HighwayMode` 为源的成组迁移，对它的全部后代生效，包括 `FinishState`。于是进入 `FinishState` 之后，只要 `urban_way=true` 成立就会被带到 `UrbanMode`；再由 `:34 UrbanMode --> HighwayMode : high_way=true` 回来，经 `:9` 的默认入口落到 `enter_hwy`、走到 `cruise`，最后由 `:15` 或 `:16` 再回到 `FinishState`——一个可以反复走的环。`:43 AutonomousMode --> FinishState : auto_finished=true` 则会让整个 `AutonomousMode` 退出并重入。\n\n所以作者用来表达终止的那个状态并不真正终止任何东西。\n\n被违反的是 NL 第 6 句「The HighwayMode ends when the system transitions to FinishState, triggered by the `auto_finished=true` condition」所表达的终止意图。",

        "content": "1. The system begins in the AutonomousMode state, which transitions into the InitialState substate, marking the starting point of the autonomous driving mode. \n2.
